title: Induction Head Detection Consistency Test: A Minimal Reproducibility Benchmark for a Well-Understood Circuit

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: If even the simplest well-understood circuit shows disagreement across operationalizations, more complex safety-relevant circuit claims are unreliable. This is a foundational validation test for the entire circuit discovery enterprise. Clear chain to trustworthiness of interpretability claims.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: GPT-2-Small and Pythia-160M are small models. TransformerLens tutorials cover induction head detection. Three detection criteria are all documented. Pairwise Jaccard similarity is trivial to compute. Very beginner-friendly.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Two small models, three detection criteria, pairwise agreement. Deliverable is a Jaccard similarity table and a list of robustly vs contested heads. Extremely tight scope. Could be completed well within 30 hours.
